citations.assessment: Elijah speaks to Bar Hi Hi, with an alternative that names Rabbi Elazar.
Bar Hi Hi addresses Hillel at the immediately preceding locus. The exact tractate is Chagigah despite Heilprin’s printed form.
The related entry acknowledges the Hi Hi form and records Hillel.

holds.reason: The printed locator is Chaninah although the passage is Chagigah 9b.
